summary:
plan.md is written: six flat-roofed blocks, each built on its exact turned footprint (no squaring off), so every face steps like a staircase. Each straight run of wall is one bay of two windows, with proud base, cornice, bays and signs one cell in front of the wall.
Inn (cream stucco): courtyard, stacked bay windows, green-and-white awnings, rooftop deck. 101 Stewart: brick and beige ribbon storeys with three terraced setbacks. Palihotel: brick with grey cornice and stacked red PALIHOTEL sign. The Fix: tall brick warehouse, fire escapes, stepped parapet.
Hahn: GREEN TORTOISE board stepping along Pike St. Pike St Commercial: red neon band, one word per bay. Lower storeys reach the ground on the downhill west side; all blocks exist in 1.21.1. Nothing has been built or rendered from this plan yet. Six flat-roofed blocks built on their exact stepped (turned-grid) footprints, with storeys built down to the ground on the downhill west side. The Inn is cream stucco with stacked bays, awnings and a roof deck. The other five are brick: 101 Stewart (terraced), Palihotel (blade sign), the Fix (fire escapes, stepped crests, water tank), the Hahn (GREEN TORTOISE sign) and Pike St (neon band).
Parts are cut by plot, plus a last dusk part for lit windows, shop glow and lanterns. elements.md has the checklist and plan.md has the palette, vocabulary, rooms and parts.
Coordinates in rooms and entrances are module space (plot-local x plus the plot offset 0, 65, 133, 196, 265, 326).

rooms.name: Inn cafe
rooms.purpose: Lit ground-floor cafe behind the green and white awnings: counter of top spruce slabs, small tables, lit candles and hanging lanterns. It should glow warm at dusk through the glass.
rooms.ways_in: N doors at x40..41 and x50..51, z1, y9 (slab ramps where G=8)

rooms.name: Inn lobby
rooms.purpose: Hotel lobby behind the entrance on the east side. Polished andesite floor, a reception desk as focal piece, two lanterns, lit through the glass.
rooms.ways_in: Hotel entrance x54 (module x54), z22..23, y9

rooms.name: 101 Stewart shop and lobby
rooms.purpose: Row of lit street-level shops and the lobby behind the polished-andesite-framed glass. Counters, shelves with candles and lanterns, a warm modern-office lobby.
rooms.ways_in: N wall z1: lobby door x97..98 (local 32..33), shop doors x89..90 and x107..108, y3

rooms.name: Palihotel shop
rooms.purpose: Corner shop under the green fascia and awnings: a bar-like counter, shelves with pots and candles, warm lanterns.

rooms.name: Fix west shop
rooms.purpose: Small lit shop behind the large west arches on the downhill side, cut into the hill: counter, shelves and lantern light. The floor steps up to the ground (G is above y1 inward).
rooms.ways_in: W doors at local x9, z18..19 and z22..23, y1

rooms.name: Hahn shop
rooms.purpose: Hostel and shopfront bay on Pike Street: reception counter and a rack of postcards, green-themed, lit through the glass.
rooms.ways_in: South doors of the Hahn (hostel door snapped to a valid south tread), y4

rooms.name: Pike St shop
rooms.purpose: Corner hardware and supply shop behind the big windows and under the red neon band: shelves, barrels, hanging lanterns.
rooms.ways_in: S door local x6..7, z50, y2

parts.name: Inn at the Market

Shell on ring 1 from G to y28 with the plinth, the polished course, string course and cornice, cut_sandstone quoins, stacked stucco bays on the 8-long W/N/S treads (y15..27), juliet balconies on the others, the courtyard void x24..37 z18..33 with its paved floor and gate arch (x24..26 z49), cafe awnings, doors, spruce deck y29 with parapet, pergolas, umbrellas, azalea planters, glazed pavilion and lift tower. parts.name: 101 Stewart tower
parts.scope: Plot 1 (x65..128 local x0..63, z0..72). Brick shell with the shop base (G..8), brick and sandstone ribbon storeys with piers every 7 and pilasters on the risers, the three terraces (y49..68), penthouse and sandstone cap, doors. parts.name: Palihotel
parts.scope: Plot 2 (x133..191). Brick shell G..28, polished andesite plinth, shopfronts with green fascia and awnings, windows with sills and lintels, oriel bays on the W treads and N z=6, polished andesite cornice, parapet, the lit PALIHOTEL blade sign on x53..55 z10, doors, HVAC boxes. Vocab: groundColumn, plinth, shopfront, awning, bayRhythm, orielBay, cornice, bladeSign, doorPair, hvacBox.

parts.name: The Fix building
parts.scope: Plot 3 (x196..260). Brick shell G..36, rusticated base on the W treads, large L1 openings, multi-pane windows with sills and terracotta lintels, belt courses y8 and y29, fire escapes on the two W treads (x=8 z16..23, x=2 z36..43), parapet with stepped crests to y41, wooden water tank, stair bulkhead, doors. Vocab: groundColumn, plinth, bayRhythm, cornice, fireEscape, steppedCrest, waterTank, bulkhead, doorPair.

parts.name: Hahn and Pike Street Commercial
parts.scope: Plot 4 (x265..321) and plot 5 (x326..387). Hahn: brick shell G..19, andesite base, shopfronts with green awnings, cornice with brackets, parapet, skylight, the stepping GREEN TORTOISE board with lanterns. Pike St Commercial: brick shell G..15, shop windows with mullions, the red neon band with PIKE, PLACE, SUPPLY, CO., sandstone terracotta L2, parapet with chiseled panels, HVAC boxes. Vocab: groundColumn, plinth, shopfront, awning, bayRhythm, cornice, bannerSign, doorPair, deckAndParapet, hvacBox.

parts.name: Dusk lighting and grounds
parts.scope: All plots, built last. Lit-window pattern (froglight at ring 3, hanging lanterns at ring 2, about 70% of windows), shop glow behind every L1 window, lanterns at every door and under bands and awnings, courtyard dressing, azalea planters at ground level. Vocab: windowLit, shopGlow, doorLantern, azaleaPlanter, courtyardWall.

recruit.why: Stepped brick and stucco walls on the turned footprint, plinths down to the sloping ground, quoins, cornices and belt courses
Bay and oriel windows, ribbon glazing, shopfronts and dark oak door pairs with slab-step approaches
The PALIHOTEL blade sign, GREEN TORTOISE board and the neon band words, letters read left to right from the street
Fire escapes, iron_bars balconies and rails, the water tank hoops and legs
Flat roofs by hand: decks, parapets, coping, stepped crests, terraces, HVAC and the Inn's roof deck
Azalea planters, rooftop pergolas and umbrellas, courtyard planting
The dusk scene: froglight behind windows, hanging lanterns, door and awning lamps, lit shop interiors
Awnings in one colour per shop, shop displays seen through the glass
